adblock.title: Adblock
adblock.help: Blocks ads, trackers and malware domains for every device that uses the router for DNS: lookups of listed domains get no answer.
adblock.busy: adblock was busy with another run; try again when it has finished.
adblock.feeds_help: Lists downloaded from the internet. Bigger lists block more but use more memory (S < M < L < XL < XXL). Applied with the other settings.
adblock.feeds_custom: This router uses its own feed catalogue (/etc/adblock/adblock.custom.feeds).
adblock.categories_help: This feed is only downloaded with at least one category.
adblock.dns_help: The DNS server on the router that answers your devices; OpenWrt uses dnsmasq.
adblock.safesearch_help: Forces the safe search mode of Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, YouTube and others.
adblock.force_help: Redirects DNS queries of LAN devices to the router, so they cannot bypass the blocklists with their own DNS server.
adblock.trigger_help: Wait for these interfaces (e.g. wan) before downloading the lists at boot. Empty: start right away.
adblock.list_block_help: Domains that are always blocked, one per line (subdomains included). Saving updates adblock right away.
adblock.list_allow_help: Domains that are never blocked, even when a feed lists them, one per line. Saving updates adblock right away.
adblock.list_saved_busy: Saved; adblock is busy and uses the list from its next update.
adblock.lookup_help: Shows whether a domain (or one of its parent domains) is in the active blocklist or in the local lists.
